title: Reverse-Engineering the Mechanical Secrets of 100% Autonomous Software Engineering Agents

five_mechanical_secrets.mechanism: Thought -> Action -> Observation -> Reflexion. Automated self-healing driven by terminal exit codes and stack trace parsing without human intervention.

five_mechanical_secrets.pillar: 2. AST-Aware Call Graph & Merkle Tree Indexing
five_mechanical_secrets.mechanism: Fast local symbol resolution, call graph traversal, and embedding Merkle trees to feed the model only high-relevance code snippets instead of bloated files.
Zero-risk isolated execution in shadow worktrees (git worktree add). Total reversibility with atomic fast-forward merges upon 100% test pass.
Every tool call and agent transition is clamped to JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 strict mode. Disallowed inputs are rejected at the runtime boundary.
Cyclic state graphs with automatic context scrubbing. Terminal outputs are condensed into structured telemetry, preventing context window saturation.

cursor_native_integration_path.execution: Pure Node.js L0 Control Plane driving Cursor Composer agents
